quote: So little cause for carollings / Of such ecstatic sound / Was written on terrestrial things / Afar or nigh around, / That I could think there trembled through / His happy good-night air / Some blessed Hope, whereof he knew / And I was unaware.
source: Thomas Hardy, The Darkling Thrush, the closing stanza, lines 25 to 32, Poems of the Past and the Present (1901)
